review.rationale: Sourced from HotelLarge BLDG_OCC_SCH, the hotel BUILDING occupancy - high overnight because that is when guests are in the building. Applied to a lobby it claimed 0.90 occupancy at 03:00 and 0.30 at midday, while the lobby's own lighting source peaks at 20:00 and sits at 0.10 overnight. A hotel lobby is busy at morning checkout, quiet mid-afternoon, busy again through evening check-in, and nearly empty overnight. Replaced with that shape, which also lets the derived equipment track occupancy sensibly rather than running all night.
